name: Microchannel Compact Welded Plate Heat Exchanger (PCHE)
full_description: The official product page describes PCHE as one of the most efficient and compact new heat exchangers, offering very high safety and stability. It is presented as a microchannel heat exchanger developed for high-efficiency heat transfer systems in micro and small gas turbines, LNG, heat pumps, nuclear power, hydrogen energy, supercritical CO2 power generation, and energy storage applications.
advantage: Officially stated heat transfer efficiency above 98%.
Officially stated operating temperature range from -196℃ to 800℃.
Officially stated compactness up to 2500 m2/m3.
